topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I really should have double-checked the signs. I mean, who would think of putting a no-parking sign on someone's own driveway, right? I could kick myself for not noticing the city had put up a temporary restriction for some kind of roadwork. Now here I am, stuck calling around for the towing company, trying to figure out how to get my car back without making a huge scene. I guess I just have to take a deep breath, pay the fees, and be more careful from now on. It’s a learning moment, no doubt.
